# telnyx_display_identity_record_phone_number_batch (Data Source)

A batch of phone numbers added to a DIR together, with the status of each.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `batch_id` (String)
- `dir_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `dir_display_name` (String) The DIR's display name at the time the batch was read.
- `documents` (Attributes List) Documents attached to this batch (e.g. a Letter of Authorization). Empty when none were supplied at add time. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--documents))
- `enterprise_id` (String)
- `phone_numbers` (Attributes List) All phone numbers in this batch, with per-number status. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phone_numbers))
- `status` (String) Phone-number lifecycle status. - `submitted` / `in_review` - Telnyx is reviewing the batch this number belongs to. - `verified` - approved; the DIR's display identity will be shown on outbound calls from this number. - `unsuccessful` - Telnyx rejected this submission; the customer may re-add to retry. - `suspended` - temporarily disabled (e.g. by an active infringement claim on the DIR). - `expired` - verification expired; re-add to renew. - `permanently_rejected` - terminal; cannot be re-added on this or any other DIR you own.
- `submitted_at` (String) When the batch was created (and implicitly submitted for vetting).
- `total_count` (Number) Number of phone numbers in this batch (length of `phone_numbers`).

<a id="nestedatt--documents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `documents`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) An optional note describing this document, for example what it proves.
- `document_id` (String) Id returned by the Telnyx Documents API after you upload the file (upload via `POST /v2/documents`; see https://developers.telnyx.com/api/documents).
- `document_type` (String) Type of supporting document. Pick the closest match to what the file actually contains; `other` triggers manual vetting and may slow approval. The matching short_name reference list is at `GET /v2/dir/document_types`.


<a id="nestedatt--phone_numbers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phone_numbers`

Read-Only:

- `batch_id` (String) Id of the batch this number was vetted as part of.
- `created_at` (String)
- `dir_id` (String)
- `enterprise_id` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `loa_document_id` (String) Id of the Letter of Authorization document attached to this number's batch.
- `phone_number` (String) E.164 with leading `+`.
- `rejection_reason` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phone_numbers--rejection_reason))
- `status` (String) Phone-number lifecycle status. - `submitted` / `in_review` - Telnyx is reviewing the batch this number belongs to. - `verified` - approved; the DIR's display identity will be shown on outbound calls from this number. - `unsuccessful` - Telnyx rejected this submission; the customer may re-add to retry. - `suspended` - temporarily disabled (e.g. by an active infringement claim on the DIR). - `expired` - verification expired; re-add to renew. - `permanently_rejected` - terminal; cannot be re-added on this or any other DIR you own.
- `updated_at` (String)
- `verified_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--phone_numbers--rejection_reason"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phone_numbers.rejection_reason`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String)
- `detail` (String)
- `message` (String) Customer-visible free-text comment from the Telnyx vetting team. Only the first entry of `rejection_reasons` carries this; the rest are `null`.
- `title` (String)
